theorems.name: Submission.dorag_ha_lsc_exhaustion
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (R E : ℝ) (f : Euclid n → ℝ), 0 < R → ContinuousOn f (ball (0 : Euclid n) R) → (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) R, 0 ≤ f x) → (∀ r, 0 < r → r < R → ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) r, f x ≤ E) → IntegrableOn f (ball (0 : Euclid n) R) ∧ ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, f x ≤ E
